name: Leaderboard
badge: shared web component — canvas and audience
summary: The ranked score list for the slide canvas and the audience phone, one look after the presenter leaderboard: a neutral rank circle, a deck-palette bar per row inside a full-width track, the score with its unit and points gained, an optional heading, and, on the phone only, the participant's own row marked with a plain "(you)" after the name.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-leaderboard> — for the presenter canvas and the audience phone alike. It draws the list only; place it in a deck container or modal. Themed from the deck: call applyCanvasDeck (canvas) or applyDeck (audience) once, and it reads --aha-deck-* tokens only. Every participant is listed: give it a height and the list scrolls inside it, the heading and count staying put.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, so the canvas and the phone render identically. Set `entries` as a JSON attribute or a property.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: stage 56px tall, 16px gap; phone 44px tall (the touch floor), 8px gap. A rank circle, a full-width track (deck fill, radius 8) holding the bar and the name, and the score column at the end

spec.label: Heading
spec.value: `heading` shows a centred title with a secondary-ink count line (`count-label`, "{n} players") above the list; without `heading` neither shows

spec.label: Rank circle
spec.value: circle 32 (stage) / 28 (phone), the deck fill with the deck ink, the same for every rank: no accent fill, no podium treatment. No trophy unless `trophy` is set, then rank 1 shows the system-trophy glyph (the numeral stays for screen readers)

spec.label: Bar
spec.value: inside the track, width = score / top score, rounded like the track. Row n takes deck palette colour n (--aha-deck-palette-<n>, cycling) and its name takes the matching -ink; where the deck wrote no palette the bar is the deck accent. A row with no score keeps a stub of its colour (--aha-viz-stub-length). The name and the tag are drawn twice, the deck-ink copy clipped to the track and the palette-ink copy to the bar, so each piece is drawn once and the ink flips exactly at the bar's edge. Every text reaches WCAG AA 4.5:1 on its own background as long as the palette colour does with its -ink (a palette colour that reaches 4.5:1 with neither ink cannot be fixed here). bar="false" removes it

spec.label: Avatar slot
spec.value: a fixed 32 / 28px slot for an emoji or image, so names and scores align whatever the glyph width

spec.label: Score
spec.value: semibold, tabular, right-aligned in a column sized to the widest score, then the unit (`score-suffix`, default "p") and, when entries carry a `delta`, the points gained in a smaller secondary-ink "+92". The columns stay aligned; no delta, no column

spec.label: Own row
spec.value: audience phone only: the row for `me` carries a plain " (you)" after the name, in the same ink as the name (the palette ink on the bar, the deck ink on the track) and regular weight, with no border, fill or pill and no outline round the track. A long name ellipsises and "(you)" stays visible. The canvas is seen by everyone: it never shows "(you)" or any own-row marking, whatever `me` is set to. All phone row text is the body default size (14px, --aha-size-default). The own row is scrolled into view on render and when it moves

spec.label: Scroll
spec.value: every participant is listed, never summarised as "and N more". With a height (or max-height) on the element the list scrolls inside it and the heading and count stay fixed; with none every row shows. Rows move with a short slide on reorder, measured once per update, so 50 or more rows cost one layout read and one write

spec.label: Teams
spec.value: an entry with `members` shows a member count; its bar is the palette colour of its rank like every other row

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: rows slide to their new rank (FLIP, --aha-motion-viz-reorder), the bar and ink clip grow together and the score counts up; none under prefers-reduced-motion

spec.label: Empty and loading
spec.value: one line "No scores yet"; five skeleton rows while `loading`

props.name: entries
props.type: JSON [{id, name, score, delta?, avatar?, members?}]
props.desc: The scores, in any order. Also the `entries` property. `delta` is the points gained, shown small after the score; `avatar` is an emoji or an image URL; `members` makes the row a team

props.name: me
props.desc: The participant's entry id (phone only, ignored on the canvas): its row gets "(you)" after the name and is scrolled into view

props.name: bar
props.desc: bar="false" removes the bar behind the name

props.name: trophy
props.desc: Opt in: shows the system-trophy glyph on rank 1

props.name: size
props.desc: One look at two scales: stage for the presenter canvas, phone for the audience

props.name: palette-size
props.desc: How many deck palette colours the rows cycle through

props.name: label
props.desc: The list's accessible name; defaults to `heading`, then Leaderboard

props.name: heading
props.desc: Shows a centred title above the list, with the player count under it

props.name: count-label
props.desc: The count line under the heading

props.name: score-suffix
props.desc: The unit after each score; an empty value drops it

props.name: you-label
props.desc: The text after the participant's own name

props.name: members-label
props.desc: The member count on a team row

props.name: rank-label
props.desc: Announced politely when the participant's own rank changes

props.name: ink / accent
props.desc: Deck ink and accent for this element only; normally inherited from applyCanvasDeck or applyDeck

whenToUse.when: any ranked list of participants or teams by score, on the canvas or the phone
results of a question, not a ranking of people

opinion.note: Never hand-build a leaderboard row. Place the element in a deck container or modal (--aha-deck-container-*, --aha-deck-modal-*) and give it a height.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the stage example with no deck applied (DS defaults).

selfCheck.label: neutral rank circles, one deck palette colour per row, no trophy by default, no status hue

highlights: One rank circle, bar, score and gain row on the canvas and the phone
Row n takes deck palette colour n, with its matching ink
Optional heading with a player count; ties share a rank, on the phone the own row carries a plain (you), every participant is listed and the list scrolls
Rows fit the element's height; rank changes slide and scores count up

composedOf.note: one per row, from applyCanvasDeck (canvas) and applyDeck (audience phone, the deck-palette PR); the matching -ink pair colours the name on the bar
the stub of a row with no score

a11y.role: an ordered list named by `label`; each row reads rank, name, score with its unit and gain, and, on the phone, "(you)" after the name; the clipped copy of the name is aria-hidden
a11y.note: A polite live region announces the participant's own new rank. Motion is off under prefers-reduced-motion.
